title: ACK Red Blood Cell Lysis Buffer
description: Standard ammonium–chloride–potassium (ACK) lysis buffer for selective removal of red blood cells from murine or human single-cell suspensions.

title: BHK Cell and Virus Propagation Medium
description: This medium is used for propagation of BHK-21 cells and for LCMV production workflows.

title: FACS Buffer
description: PBS + FCS wash/staining buffer for flow cytometry (FACS), without EDTA.

title: 2x Freezing Medium (R0 + 10% FCS + 20% DMSO)
description: Preparation of 2x freezing medium for cryopreservation of PBMCs and other lymphocytes. Mixed 1:1 with cell suspension to yield standard 10% DMSO freezing medium.

title: 3% Medium (IEL Wash/Base Medium)
description: Low-serum RPMI wash medium used for intestinal washes and as the base for IEL Strip Medium.

title: IEL Shake Medium
description: EDTA/RPMI medium used for the mechanical shake washes after DTT/EDTA epithelial stripping.

title: IEL Strip Medium (DTT/EDTA)
description: DTT/EDTA epithelial stripping medium for releasing intraepithelial lymphocytes from the small intestine.

title: L929 Cell Propagation Medium
description: This medium is used for routine propagation of L929 cells for LCMV production workflows.

title: LCMV Plaque Assay Medium
description: Medium used to overlay infected Vero cell monolayers during LCMV plaque assays.

title: Mouse Liver Digestion Buffer
description: Collagenase and DNase I digestion buffer for enzymatic dissociation of mouse liver tissue. Supports Collagenase D or Collagenase IV in a DMEM, PBS, or HBSS base.

title: MACS Buffer
description: PBS + FCS + EDTA buffer for magnetic-activated cell sorting (MACS) and general washes.

title: NK Cell Culture Medium (cRPMI for Murine NK Cells)
description: Complete NK culture medium (cRPMI) for murine NK cells, including RPMI 1640 supplemented with FCS, antibiotics, HEPES, sodium pyruvate, NEAA, and beta-mercaptoethanol. IL-15 is added fresh at the time of culture and is not included in the stored base medium.

title: 37% Percoll Solution (= 33% final Percoll)
description: Percoll density solution for enrichment of leukocytes from digested liver tissue. 37% of isotonic Percoll stock, equivalent to 33% final Percoll.

title: R0 Medium (RPMI Without Serum)
description: Serum-free RPMI 1640 medium used for dilution of whole blood prior to Ficoll gradient separation, and for initial PBMC washes.

title: R10 Medium (RPMI + 10% FCS + Pen/Strep)
description: Complete RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with 10% fetal calf serum and Penicillin/Streptomycin for culture and washing of human PBMCs and lymphocytes.

title: RBC Lysis Buffer (Hybrimax / Commercial)
description: Red blood cell lysis buffer based on commercial HybriMax or equivalent RBC lysis reagent.

title: T Cell Medium (RPMI + 10% FCS + Supplements)
description: Complete RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with FCS, Penicillin/Streptomycin, beta-mercaptoethanol, and L-glutamine for mouse T cell and NLC culture. Optional supplements: sodium pyruvate, HEPES, MEM NEAAs.

title: Vero Cell Propagation Medium
description: This medium is used for routine propagation of Vero cells.

title: CellTrace Violet (CTV) Staining of Lymphocytes
description: Staining of lymphocytes (e.g. PBMCs) with CellTrace Violet (CTV) to enable analysis of cell proliferation by flow cytometry.

title: Sony Spectral Cell Analyzer ID7000
description: Standard operating procedure for startup, daily QC, experiment setup, single-stain acquisition and spectral unmixing, sample acquisition, data export, and cleaning/shutdown of the Sony Spectral Cell Analyzer ID7000 at the Flow Cytometry Core Facility (FCCF), University Hospital Bonn.

title: Sony ID7000 Data Handling and Storage
description: Standard operating procedure for exporting, organizing, transferring, and deleting data generated on the Sony Spectral Cell Analyzer ID7000 systems, including FCS files, experiment files, and reference controls.

title: Standard Flow Cytometry Staining (Surface, Intracellular, Intranuclear)
description: Standard workflow for surface, intracellular, and intranuclear staining of cells for flow cytometry, including optional tetramer staining performed together with surface antibodies.

title: 4D-Nucleofector CRISPR–Cas9 RNP Delivery to T and NK Cells
description: Unified 4D-Nucleofector protocol for CRISPR–Cas9 RNP delivery into primary mouse T cells, primary mouse NK cells, human CD8 T cells, and NK-92 cells using cell-type–specific buffer and pulse codes.

title: Isolation of Human PBMCs from Whole Blood by Ficoll Gradient
description: Isolation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from whole human blood using Ficoll density gradient centrifugation, followed by washing and optional cryopreservation.

title: K-562 Cell Line Culture Protocol
description: Culture and maintenance of the human K-562 erythroleukemia cell line, including thawing, routine passaging, and cryopreservation.

title: KHYG-1 Cell Line Culture Protocol
description: Culture and maintenance of the human KHYG-1 NK-like cell line, including thawing, routine passaging, IL-2 supplementation, and cryopreservation.

title: NK-92 Cell Line Culture Protocol
description: Culture and maintenance of the human NK-92 cell line, including thawing, IL-2–supplemented culture, routine passaging, and cryopreservation.

title: Mouse Blood Processing to Single-Cell Suspension
description: Processing of mouse peripheral blood to obtain leukocyte-enriched single-cell suspensions for flow cytometry and immunological assays.

title: Mouse Bone Marrow Isolation to Single-Cell Suspension
description: Isolation of mouse bone marrow cells from long bones for flow cytometry, sorting, and downstream immunological assays.

title: Mouse Small Intestinal Intraepithelial Lymphocyte (IEL) Isolation
description: Isolation of intraepithelial lymphocytes (IELs) from the mouse small intestine for flow cytometry and immunophenotyping, using DTT/EDTA epithelial stripping, mechanical agitation, and Percoll density centrifugation.

title: LCMV Infection Models (WE, Clone 13, Docile, Armstrong)
description: Standardized mouse infection protocols for acute and chronic LCMV models, with emphasis on LCMV-WE and LCMV-Clone 13, including dose rationale, virus handling, timing, and expected immunological outcomes.

title: LCMV Focus-Forming Assay (Immunofocus)
description: Quantification of infectious titer (FFU/mL) of LCMV using antibody-based detection of infected foci on Vero cells with semi-solid overlay

title: LCMV Plaque Assay on Vero Cells
description: Quantification of infectious titer (PFU/mL)

title: LCMV Production: Unified Multi-Strain Protocol (Armstrong, Clone 13, WE, Docile)
description: Propagation on fibroblast cell lines and harvest of high-titer stocks.

title: LCMV Viral Load Quantification by GP-Based SYBR Green qPCR
description: qPCR viral titre

title: Mouse Liver Digestion to Single-Cell Suspension
description: Isolation of viable mouse liver single-cell suspensions for downstream flow cytometry, sorting, and single-cell applications.

title: Mouse Lung Digestion to Single-Cell Suspension
description: Enzymatic digestion of mouse lung to generate viable single-cell suspensions for flow cytometry, sorting, and single-cell omics workflows.

title: NLC Adoptive Transfer (Liver-derived NK-like Cells)
description: Adoptive transfer of liver-derived NLCs for downstream phenotyping and functional studies, including planning calculations for donor requirements and standard timelines for LCMV- and BDL+LCMV-based experiments.

title: P14 Adoptive Transfer (GP33-specific CD8 T cells)
description: Adoptive transfer of congenically marked naive P14 CD8 T cells for tracking antigen-specific responses in LCMV infection models. Focus on transfer dose, timing, injection preparation, and core readouts.

title: Single-Tube PCR Genotyping of Ptprc^a^ (JAXBoy, CD45.1) and Ptprc^b^ (C57BL/6J, CD45.2)
description: Validated allele-specific endpoint PCR using long-tailed primers.

title: Mouse Spleen Dissociation to Single-Cell Suspension
description: Preparation of mouse spleen single-cell suspensions for flow cytometry, sorting, and downstream immunological assays.

title: In vitro NK Cell Proliferation Assay Using CellTrace Dyes
description: In vitro proliferation assay for murine NK cells using CellTrace dyes, starting from splenic NK cells isolated by magnetic enrichment and/or sorting, and cultured in NK medium containing IL-15.

title: Mouse Tumour Digestion to Single-Cell Suspension
description: Enzymatic and mechanical dissociation of mouse solid tumours to obtain viable single-cell suspensions for flow cytometry, sorting, and single-cell transcriptomic applications.

title: xCELLigence Real-Time Cytotoxicity Assay for LCMV-Infected Fibroblasts
description: Real-time impedance-based cytotoxicity assay using xCELLigence RTCA to measure effector cell killing of LCMV-infected and uninfected C57BL/6J fibroblasts. Covers fibroblast culture, in vitro LCMV infection, E-plate setup, and real-time cytotoxicity measurement.

title: Plate-bound stimulation of NLCs (anti-CD3e +/- anti-NK1.1 + soluble anti-CD28)
description: Simple 96-well plate-bound stimulation of sorted NLCs for 3 days followed by IL-2-driven expansion.
